artworks.title: Et celui qui était monté dessus se nommait la Mort (And his name that sat on him was Death)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on chine collé
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a skeletal figure riding a horse. It is rendered in black and white, with the skeletal figure holding a staff or scythe. The horse is in motion. The scene is dark and moody, with heavy shading creating an ominous atmosphere. The skeletal figure is the focal point of the composition, set against a dark backdrop. At the bottom, there is text in French.

artworks.title: Apres cela je vis descendre du ciel un ange qui avait la clef de l'abime, et une grande chaine en sa main (And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand)
artworks.description: The image depicts an angelic figure with large wings and outstretched arms descending while holding a heavy chain. The figure wears a helmet or crown and has a determined expression. Dark shading creates a dramatic and ethereal atmosphere.

artworks.title: Frontispiece
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged creature with a humanoid face surrounded by text. The drawing showcases intricate line work to render a dark figure with broad wings and a mysterious face. The creature appears to emerge from the shadows, with fine lines and dark shading adding depth and texture to the form. Below this image, there is text in an elegant serif font, which reads: "A Gustave Flaubert six dessins pour la Tentation de St Antoine par Odilon Redon."

artworks.title: Saint-Antoine...A travers ses longs cheveux qui lui couvraient la figure, j'ai cru reconnaitre Ammonaria (Saint Anthony: "Beneathe her long hair , which covered her face, I thought I recognized Ammonaria)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a dramatic scene. The drawing is in a monochromatic, textured style that plays with light and shadow. The central figure is standing with legs crossed and one arm raised. They are in front of a large column. A second figure is partially visible to the left, also in a dynamic posture. The background is dark and textured, creating a moody atmosphere. The drawing conveys a sense of narrative and emotion through its use of line and shading.

artworks.title: Une longue chrysalide couleur de sang (A longchrysalis, the color of blood)
artworks.description: The image shows a figure curled around a pedestal in a dimly lit space. The figure has a halo-like glow around its head and appears to be bent over or resting on the pedestal. The drawing has rich texture and an eerie and dramatic vibe. The backdrop suggests an interior environment with arched details, creating a somber and mystical atmosphere. The composition uses light and dark contrasts to add depth and focus to the scene.

artworks.title: La Mort: Mon ironie depasse toutes les autres! (Death: My iron surpasses all others!)
Saint-Antoine: Il doit y avoir quelque part des figures primordiales dont les corps ne sont que les images (Saint Anthony: "Somewhere there must be primordial shapes whose bodiesare only images")
artworks.description: The image features a complex pattern of lines and shapes creating an abstract design, with a central eye-like shape and jagged lines suggesting the form of a creature's head. Bold, dark strokes above the eye shape add texture to the area, resembling hair or fur spreading out in various directions. The abstract composition evokes the image of an animal's eye, possibly that of a fish or reptile, hinting at a mythical or fantastical creature hidden in the shadows.

artworks.title: Le Sphynx...mon regard que rien ne peut devier, demeure tendu a travers les choses sur un horizon inaccessible. La Chimere: Moi,Je suis legere et joyeuse (The Sphinx: "My gaze, which nothing can deflect, passes through the things and remains fixed on an inaccessible horizon." The Chimera: "I am weightless and joyful")
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a sphinx and a chimera. The drawing depicts two mythical creatures against a textured background. On the left side, the sphinx is presented in a traditional manner, with a human face and shoulders adorned with a headdress, connecting to the body of a lion. On the right, the chimera is depicted as a dark figure with a lion's head, a goat's head emerging from its back, and a serpent's tail. The detailed rendering of the creatures contrasts with the artist's more abstract background, which is filled with lines and shading. The overall composition conveys an encounter between the ancient mythological beings.

artworks.title: Les Sciapodes: La tete le plus bas possible, c'est le secret du bonheur! (The Skiapods: "The head as low as possible, that is the secret of happiness!")
artworks.description: The image shows bold, dark lines with intersecting texture. There is a central form with spiky, radiating lines. The composition resembles an inverted head shape with a fuller lower portion tapering into a narrowed point. The background has a textured pattern with contrasting dark and light areas.

artworks.title: L'Aile (The Wing)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a horse with wings. The drawing depicts a horse with wings on its sides. The shading and texture create depth and form, while the lines and cross-hatching add dynamism. The lighting highlights the horse's face and body. The composition is balanced and centralized.

artworks.title: La Ronde
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and softly etched shapes that form an abstract depiction. The scene features human-like figures that appear to be interacting or dancing. In the background, lines converge to create abstracted hills or mountains with a suggestion of a structural form resembling a sail or tower.

artworks.title: Antonin Proust
artworks.description: The sketch shows a profile view of a man's head and neck. His head is turned to the right with his gaze forward. Features include a prominent nose, well-defined forehead, deep-set eyes, full beard, and long, neatly styled hair slicked back. The drawing does not include any clothing or surrounding objects, only focusing on his facial features and hair. The background is a simple light-colored surface.

artworks.title: Antonin Proust
artworks.description: The image features an illustrated portrait showcasing the head and neck of an individual in profile view facing to the right. The person has distinct features, including a long nose, defined cheekbones, a beard, and mustache. Their hair is slicked back, showing detailed strands. The clothing is minimally depicted with a collar tapering off into the background. The plain, light-colored canvas background directs focus to the facial features.

artworks.title: Victor Hugo, De Trois Quarts
artworks.description: The image is a sketched portrait of a man's head and shoulders in a three-quarter profile position, facing to the right. The man has long, receding hair and a full beard. His facial features include deep-set eyes and prominent cheekbones. He is wearing a high-collared garment, and the name "Victor Hugo" is inscribed below the portrait. The background is plain with sketch lines for texture, and there is a handwritten note on the bottom right.

artworks.title: Victor Hugo, De Face
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of two portraits of the same man. One portrait depicts the man in a frontal position with a composed expression. He has a prominent beard and mustache, tousled hair, and simple clothing. The second portrait shows the man in a profile or three-quarter view. The artwork is set on a plain background with visible sketch lines for texture. The artist's signature is in the lower right corner with additional script.

artworks.title: Victor Hugo, De Face
artworks.description: The image shows two sketched portraits of the same man in black ink on a beige background. The primary portrait is centered at the top, depicting the man's head and shoulders at a slight angle. The man has a full beard and mustache with deep lines on his face. His hair is short and slicked back. Below and to the right is a smaller sketch of the man in a similar pose but from a different angle, showing his profile. The background is plain with crosshatched shading. There are no additional elements in the piece, and the lower right corner bears the signature "Rodin."

artworks.title: Victor Hugo, De Trois Quarts
artworks.description: The image depicts two side profiles of a man's head and shoulders. The man has a large, full beard and slightly longer hair combed back. The drawings show a neutral facial expression, focusing on the facial contours and shadows. The man appears to be wearing a collared garment, and the background is plain with a light sepia tone. There is a handwritten inscription at the bottom right corner of the paper.

artworks.title: Ames du Purgatoire
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in a minimalist style. The drawing features three intertwined figures sketched with light, delicate lines on a plain background. The figures appear in a fluid, natural pose, with the lines of their bodies suggesting movement and grace. The sketch is sparse and leaves a lot of negative space, emphasizing the contours and gentle forms of the figures.

artworks.title: Henri Becque
artworks.description: The image is an etching that features three overlapping views of a man's head and shoulders. The man has strong facial features including pronounced cheekbones, a straight nose, and a prominent jawline. His hair is styled in a classic, swept-back manner. The etching shows the man with an intense gaze, and the play of shadow and light over his face is detailed with intricate linear work. He is wearing a high-collared garment. The background features swirling lines. The bottom right corner of the image features a dedication or signature: "à Monsieur Cardon amitié Rodin."

artworks.title: The Parable of the Sower (Le Semeur de Paraboles)
artworks.description: The image shows a figure walking outdoors. They are walking in a slightly hunched position, with one arm extended forward and the other holding fabric or a bag close to their body. The person's facial features are shadowed, their hair appears tousled and medium in length, and they are wearing a loose-fitting tunic, dark pants, and shoes. The surrounding landscape includes grassy patches, sparse vegetation, and a few trees in the background. The sky appears clear, suggesting an open, rural environment.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel: Victoria Augusta
artworks.description: The image displays an intricate array of intertwining lines and shapes forming an abstract design. The composition includes symmetrical elements with flowing scrollwork around central figural elements like cherubs holding musical instruments. Other motifs include putti, fantastical creatures, and decorative urns with a Baroque sensibility. The arrangement resembles ornate carvings or tapestries, guiding the viewer's eye across the interplay of shapes and mythical forms.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel with a Birdcage
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 26.8 x 13.2 cm (10 9/16 x 5 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a detailed arrangement of lines and shapes forming an intricate pattern. Various figures and motifs, such as human faces, mythological creatures, shields, scrolls, floral elements, and winged beings, create an abstract composition resembling a tapestry. A central figure encased in a cage-like structure, along with other elements, suggests a mystical narrative within the frame.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel: Mars, God of Battles
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 26.2 x 12.9 cm (10 5/16 x 5 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This print shows an intricate symmetrical design featuring mythological figures, animals, and ornamental motifs. There is a central vertical axis around which various elements and figures are symmetrically arranged, and the page is entirely filled with designs. At the top, there is a seated figure holding two standards on either side of a Latin inscription, flanked by people with wings and others standing next to rearing horses. The middle section continues with similarly detailed adornments including classical motifs like vases, garlands, animal heads, and small cherubic figures. The lower section features what looks like a large fountain with three faces at the center, all arranged together. On either side of these faces, two people appear to be tied up. Above the faces are the letters N and R. In the bottom right and left corners, people with horns appear to ride strange dragon-like creatures with human faces.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel with Orpheus and the Judgment of Paris
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 26.5 x 13 cm (10 7/16 x 5 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a complex assembly of lines and shapes forming an abstract pattern. The composition includes circular, rectangular, and swirling motifs resembling shields and medallions. It features depictions reminiscent of classical mythology and ancient art, with elements resembling human figures, mythological creatures, and ornamental foliage. Central round medallions showcase scenes akin to small vignettes of mythical tales, surrounded by figures and creatures evoking ancient storytelling. The overall design presents a complex, abstract border filled with elements evoking stories of legendary characters and decorative art forms.
